scope: Release default-dependency test process; same OpenSSH executable/config, generated keys and sshd, SFTP v3 codec, 501 visible directory entries, 32MiB pattern upload/download verification, 64KiB transfer chunks and sequential ACK. Two warmups then alternating order in five or more pairs, 600ms idle windows. Blocking std pipes are only a healthy-network control and lack product cancellation; Python owns the overall trial timeout. Excludes GUI latency, machine cold-cache guarantees, full-heap admission and Windows runtime. Process samples can miss short-lived peaks.
sampler: libproc 每 5 ms；Mach 时间基准 125/3；进程树最多 64 项
